title: Who talks to whom
caption: Config files feed the GUC table, backends send counters and logs out, and backup and upgrade tools all go through the postmaster.

title: Changing a setting live
caption: ALTER SYSTEM only writes a file, and the new value reaches running backends after a reload sends SIGHUP.

badges.meaning: You run ALTER SYSTEM SET in psql and a backend receives it
The backend writes the new value into postgresql.auto.conf (the running value does not change yet)
The backend sends SIGHUP to the postmaster
The postmaster re-reads postgresql.conf and postgresql.auto.conf
The postmaster forwards SIGHUP to the backends, which apply the change (postmaster-only settings wait for a restart)
You see the new value and its source in pg_settings

title: The data directory map
caption: Each folder or file in the data directory belongs to one job: settings, logs and stats, or the data that backups and pg_upgrade copy.
